_comment_credentials: Required: replace both placeholders before starting the service.
_comment_vast: The current-user API exposes balance. The key is passed through requests params and is never written to logs.
_comment_goal: Daily goal is evaluated on a business day from 09:00 JST to 09:00 JST next day.
_comment_exchange: Three USDJPY providers are tried in order; the last successful rate is cached.
_comment_runtime: Set log_level to DEBUG to save the latest Vast.ai payload to logs/api_response.json.
